title: Stepper conveys step state only via color and icon, with no aria-current or text alternative
description: Stepper.jsx (components/onboarding/Stepper.jsx) distinguishes done/current/pending purely through bg color (doneBg/activeBg/pendingBg) and a CheckIcon vs. plain number — there is no aria-current="step" on the current step's container and no visually-hidden text announcing 'completed' or 'current' for screen reader users.
steps: Navigate the onboarding wizard using a screen reader (NVDA/VoiceOver)
Reach the Stepper header on any step
expectedResult: Current behavior: the screen reader announces only the step number/label text, with no indication of which step is 'current' or 'completed' — this should be flagged for remediation (add aria-current="step" and visually-hidden status text).

title: Tour tooltip Skip/close controls are keyboard-reachable and carry accessible names
description: TourTooltip.jsx gives the header close IconButton aria-label="Skip tour" and the footer Skip Button has visible text ('Skip'/'Done') — this is a positive control to guard against regressions removing these labels during a redesign.
steps: While the platform tour is active, Tab through the page using only the keyboard
Confirm the header 'X' IconButton and footer 'Skip'/'Back'/'Next' buttons all receive visible focus and can be activated with Enter/Space
expectedResult: All 4 controls are reachable in a logical Tab order, each has a non-empty accessible name (via aria-label or visible text), and Enter/Space activates them.

title: Platform tour blocks body scroll while active but does not trap keyboard focus inside the tooltip
description: PlatformTour.jsx sets document.body.style.overflow='hidden' while active (lines 18-25) to prevent background scrolling, but there is no focus-trap implementation around the portal-rendered TourOverlay/TourTooltip — keyboard Tab can move focus into covered page content that is visually obscured by the spotlight overlay.
steps: Repeatedly press Tab and observe where visible focus goes
expectedResult: Current behavior: focus can leave the tooltip and land on elements underneath the darkened overlay, which are not intended to be interactive during the tour — this should be flagged for remediation (wrap the tour in a focus trap).

title: Wizard form validation errors are not programmatically associated with their inputs
description: step-1/page.jsx and step-4/page.jsx render validation errors as a plain <Text color="red.400"> sibling of the form, with no aria-live region and no aria-invalid/aria-describedby link from the FormControl/Input to the error text — a screen reader user submitting an incomplete form may not be notified that an error occurred.
steps: Using a screen reader, submit /onboarding/step-1 with the Company size field left blank
expectedResult: Current behavior: the 'Please fill in both fields.' message is not automatically announced, and the Company size Select is not marked aria-invalid or linked via aria-describedby to the error — this should be flagged for remediation.
